we have developed novel dual inhibitors of histones deacetylase and HSP90.

the design, synthesis and evaluation of N-alkyl-hyroxybenzoylanilide hydroxamate derivatives as dual inhibitors of HSP90 and HDAC.
the development of novel dual HDAC-HSP90 inhibitors with potent HDAC inhibitory activity.
the design of novel dual HDAC and Hsp90 inhibitors as potential anti-cancer agents.
